params.name: identifier
params.description: OAI identifier of a record (required for GetRecord; optional for ListMetadataFormats).

params.name: metadataPrefix
params.description: Metadata format prefix (e.g. oai_dc). Required for GetRecord, ListRecords, ListIdentifiers.

params.name: from
params.description: Lower bound for selective harvesting by datestamp (UTC).

params.name: until
params.description: Upper bound for selective harvesting by datestamp (UTC).

params.name: set
params.description: Set spec for selective harvesting by set membership.

params.name: resumptionToken
params.description: Flow-control token returned in a previous incomplete list response.

items.docs: Single OAI-PMH entry point. The `verb` parameter selects the operation. Supported verbs are Identify, ListMetadataFormats, ListSets, ListIdentifiers, ListRecords, and GetRecord. Selective harvesting parameters (from, until, set, metadataPrefix, identifier, resumptionToken) apply per verb as defined by the OAI-PMH 2.0 protocol.
